link_fixes.original_markdown: The two additional voice LFOs move filter cutoff, square PWM or sine FM index using sine/triangle shapes. Cutoff movement creates slow breathing or rhythmic filtering; PWM adds changing harmonic color; a small FM-index modulation varies brightness. Free rates reach 20 Hz, and synced rates follow native transport tempo. These slots are separate from pitch vibrato. Avoid deep/high-rate modulation with strong resonance or high-frequency FM; safe parameter clamping does not guarantee a pleasant or alias-free sound. The [two-LFO example](examples.md#two-voice-lfos) shows a filtered PWM pad.

# Sound design with TiSynthEngine

TiSynthEngine generates sound with oscillators, without recorded samples. Pitch, waveform, envelope, movement and level define each sound, from interface feedback and musical cues to alarms, retro effects and simple percussion.

Additional [curated recipes](recipes.md) provide application sound and interaction variants.
